headline: Indian Equities Open Lower as US Tech Sell-Off Triggers Asian Losses
summary: Heavy losses in US technology stocks triggered widespread selling across Asian markets, pushing Indian benchmark indices into the red at the opening bell.
why: Global equity sentiment is highly interconnected, with US technology sector sell-offs frequently rippling across emerging Asian markets.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Spillover selling from global technology markets pressured Indian indices at the open.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Steep declines in Wall Street technology shares generated risk-off sentiment and widespread selling across Asian exchanges.
